title: Cloud Users and Groups
scenario: NewVue Health has completed tenant provisioning and is now preparing the cloud identity environment for administrative use. The system administrator must create cloud user accounts, assign licenses, organize users into security groups, and confirm that departmental group membership is configured correctly. Because this is a complementary activity, use the case study and reference information below to complete the required tasks.

activities.title: Task 1 - Create a Cloud User
activities.prompt:
Drag and Drop Task
You want to create a new cloud user and complete the account setup correctly.
To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
steps: Assign the required license and create the account
answer: Assign the required license and create the account
activities.explanation: Cloud user creation begins in the user-management area and ends with licensing and account creation.

activities.title: Task 2 - Enable Service Access
activities.prompt:
Dropdown Task
You want the new user to access Microsoft 365 services immediately after account creation.
To answer, select the action that best supports that objective.
options: Assign a license during account creation
Create a local profile on the workstation
activities.answer: Assign a license during account creation
activities.explanation: Licensing is required before the cloud user can consume Microsoft 365 services.

activities.title: Task 3 - Identify Administration Areas
activities.prompt:
Matching Task
You want to continue user and group administration in the tenant.
To answer, match each administrative area on the left with the task it primarily supports on the right.
activities.explanation: Different administrative areas are used for user creation, membership management, and licensing.

activities.title: Task 4 - Select the Correct Group Type
activities.prompt:
Dropdown Task
You want to group employees by department so permissions can be managed securely.
To answer, select the group type that best supports that objective.
activities.explanation: Security groups are used for access control and permission assignment.

activities.title: Task 5 - Add Users to a Department Group
activities.prompt:
Drag and Drop Task
You want to place the correct users into a departmental security group.
To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
activities.explanation: Membership changes are performed from the group object and finalized by saving the selected members.

activities.title: Task 6 - Connect Before Automating
activities.prompt:
PowerShell Task
You want to automate user administration with PowerShell.
To answer, select the appropriate value for the missing portion of the command.
activities.explanation: Cloud administration through Microsoft Graph begins with Connect-MgGraph.

activities.title: Task 7 - Complete a User Creation Command
activities.prompt:
PowerShell Task
You want to define the sign-in identity and account state for a new cloud user.
To answer, select the appropriate value for each blank in the script.
activities.explanation: The sign-in identity is defined by UserPrincipalName, and the account must be enabled for use.
